desc: Razor VX series of EDC knives are the world's most advanced line of pocket folding knives perfectly suite for work, utility and every day carry applications. The VX2 features durable G10 scales and all steel vented liner construction and industry leading S.A.P. (Spring Assist Pivot) technology providing rapid and smooth blade deployment. Our patented RazorSafe® System delivers an unrivaled knife experience with a knife that never needs sharpening. This knifes feature a reversible deep carry pocket clip for both right or left hand carry.
